reason: Research was thin: one WebSearch returned mostly stale 2025 previews plus a Nov 8 2026 note (unverified) that futures priced a likely Fed hike on Dec 8-9, which supports the TLT short; no verified fresh catalyst to justify churn. The book is already de-risked by stops (SMH, XHB closed, large cash), the remaining legs (XLE, XOP, XBI, TLT short) sit inside their stops, and a rebuild would cost frictions with no evidence of an edge, so I hold. Decision rests mostly on the packet.
